_README: Known diagram defects that scripts/probe_diagrams.py measures on main, each
with the ticket that tracks it. THIS IS A WORKLIST, NOT A WAIVER LIST.
The probe treats this file as a ratchet, three ways:
* a finding NOT listed here fails the run;
* a finding listed here that got worse - lower contrast, smaller label, or
more labels affected - fails the run;
* an entry here that produces NO finding fails the run as `baseline-stale`.
A fixed defect cannot sit here as a permanent exemption. The file may
only shrink, and deleting an entry is part of fixing the defect.
Only `label-size`, `contrast` and `label-text` can be baselined. `render`,
`palette`, `webfont` and `ink-identity` are instrument or mechanism
failures: there is no known amount of them and no entry here can excuse one.
`worst` is the smallest number in the group (the smallest effective label
size, or the lowest painted contrast). Comparison allows 5%, which is the
measured width of the webfont-vs-fallback geometry difference. `label-text`
has no number - a label either contains the literal characters or it does
not - so its entries carry a null `worst` and only the count ratchets.
